name: com.walletbureau/mcp
description: Risk score for a Base wallet before your agent pays it: 0-100, verdict and explained flags.

environmentVariables.name: WALLETBUREAU_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Prepaid WalletBureau API key (atk_...). Optional: without any credentials the server runs on the free demo quota.

environmentVariables.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a wallet holding USDC on Base to pay per call via x402. Optional; ignored when WALLETBUREAU_API_KEY is set.

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_PRICE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Spending cap per call in USD for x402 payments. Default: 0.1.
